title: Weekend Roll of a Lost or Stolen Replacement — Calendar Convention
content:
A lost or stolen replacement under the Pharmacy Benefit whose last day falls on a weekend is rolled to the Monday.

**Convention.** The replacement's last day is today plus the replacement days less one day; the weekend roll adds two days (2) to a last day that falls on a Saturday, one day (1) to a last day that falls on a Sunday, and nothing to a last day on a weekday.

The weekend roll is added to the replacement days after they have been fixed at not fewer than one day.

### Table

| Day of the week of the replacement's last day | Weekend roll |
|---|---|
| Saturday | 2 days |
| Sunday | 1 day |
| Monday to Friday | Nothing |

### Worked calendar (hypothetical)

| Today | Replacement days | Last day | Days after the roll |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thursday | 3 | Saturday | 5 |
| Friday | 3 | Sunday | 4 |
| Wednesday | 4 | Saturday | 6 |
| Monday | 3 | Wednesday | 3 |
